_comment: Pinned list-price table for cost accounting. Prices are USD per 1M tokens at the providers' standard (non-cached, non-batch) tier. This table is a measurement input: its source and pin date are sealed into every run artifact (pricing_source / pricing_date), so a cost figure is always traceable to the table that produced it. Update by bumping 'date' and 'source' together — never silently.
basis: USD per 1M tokens, list price, standard tier (no prompt caching, no batch discount, no long-context surcharge)

gemini-3.8-flash._note: Pin reflects the 2026-09-23 rate; Google announced a step-up to $1.50/$7.50 per 1M effective 2027-01-01.

jev-1.13.0._note: Secondary-sourced Jev pricing: $0.042 per 1M input tokens, output free ("too cheap to meter") — reported via gateway announcements (Vercel/Netlify/Spring AI, Sept 2026; e.g. https://vercel.com/kb/guide/typesafe-jev-and-ai-sdk), not confirmed on an official TypeSafe pricing page as of 2026-09-23. Re-verify before launch.

source: Pre-launch provisional prices (2026-09-23). GPT-5.6 tiers verified 2026-09-23 against https://openai.com/api/pricing/ (post 2026-07-30 price cut); Claude Sonnet 5 corrected 2026-09-23 to $2/$10 against https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (the scheduled Sep-2026 rise to $3/$15 was cancelled); Jev $0.042/1M in / free out is secondary-sourced (gateway announcements), not confirmed on an official TypeSafe page. Claude/Gemini entries carried over from the pre-A2 table, unverified — re-verify every rate before launch.
